data.name: Help_OpeningText
data.value: Use the global hotkey to show or hide WindowDeck. The default shortcut is Win + `. You can change it in Settings. You can also left-click the tray icon to show or hide WindowDeck.

data.name: Help_FindingText
data.value: Type in Search windows to filter by application or visible window/document title. Windows can be grouped by application. When multiple screens are connected, numbered buttons show the current screen and move that exact window to another screen with one click.

data.name: Help_ActionsText
data.value: Click a title or row to activate that exact window. The — button minimizes that window. The × button sends one normal close request to that exact window; the application may still show its usual Save, Don't Save, or Cancel dialog. Group headers provide separate collapse, restore-all, minimize-all, and confirmed close-all actions. Right-click the window list to collapse or expand all application groups. Presentation Mode creates a Presentation group: add allowed windows with +, choose the shared screen, then lock it. Before locking, WindowDeck asks what to do with any other windows already on that screen. While locked, other visible windows are moved away from the reserved presentation screen.

data.name: Help_TrayText
data.value: WindowDeck's X button and Esc hide the flyout. WindowDeck keeps running in the tray. To shut down the application, use Tray > Exit.

data.name: Help_SettingsText
data.value: Settings includes Start with Windows, Start minimized to tray, the configurable global hotkey, grouping by application, application icons, screen numbers, minimized windows, Appearance (System, Light, or Dark), and Language (System, English, or Polski).
